_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- INTERFEROMETER mode: CHIME and the CHIME/FRB Outriggers (KKO, GBO, HCO)
_meta.companion: data/interf/chime.md (same content as Markdown, with the full quote table).
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/interf/chime/ (params{} holds the full records; top-level fields name their src alongside). DERIVED = arithmetic done here (shown). INFERRED = a mapping no source states. NOT FOUND = a gap. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.units: positions in meters: e east, n north, u up in the local tangent frame at CHIME's reference point (center of the focal lines; ITRF centroid of KKO24); angles in degrees unless stated; frequencies in GHz
_meta.scope: CHIME (four cylinders, 1024 dual-polarization feeds) and, as a second configuration, CHIME with its three CHIME/FRB Outrigger stations. Not the CHIME Pathfinder, TONE or the Algonquin 46 m (VLBI pathfinders).

OVW22.cite: CHIME Collaboration (M. Amiri et al.), "An Overview of CHIME, the Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment", ApJS 261, 29 (2022); arXiv:2201.07869v3 (24 May 2022): Sec. 2.1 Site, 2.2 Mechanical and Optical Design (Fig. 2), 2.3 Analog System, 3 Beams (Figs. 17-18), 4.1 Data Loss (Table 1), 4.2 Stability, 4.3 Noise, Appendix A Table 2. Fetched 2026-11-16

FRB18.cite: CHIME/FRB Collaboration (M. Amiri et al.), "The CHIME Fast Radio Burst Project: System Overview", ApJ 863, 48 (2018); arXiv:1803.11235v1 (29 Mar 2018): Sec. 2 and Table 1 (key properties of the CHIME telescope), Sec. 3.3 (FFT beamforming and channelization). Fetched 2026-11-16

HOLO24.cite: M. Amiri et al. (CHIME Collaboration), "Holographic Beam Measurements of the Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment (CHIME)", ApJ 976, 163 (2024); arXiv:2408.00172v1 (31 Jul 2024): Sec. 1, Table 1 (24 holography sources: declination, flux density at 600 MHz), Sec. 2.2 (Galt telescope position), Fig. 10. Fetched 2026-11-16

DRONE.cite: W. Tyndall et al., "Beam Maps of the Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment (CHIME) Measured With a Drone", IEEE Open J. Antennas Propag. 6, 928 (2025); arXiv:2407.04848v2 (revised 29 Oct 2025): Sec. III (cylinder height above ground). Fetched 2026-11-16

OUT25.cite: CHIME/FRB Collaboration, "CHIME/FRB Outriggers: Design Overview", ApJ 993, 55 (2025); arXiv:2504.05192v1 (7 Apr 2025; status "At the time of writing (early 2025)"): Abstract, Sec. 3.1 Geographic Array Design (3.1.3 Site selection), 3.2 Station Design, 6 Current Status and Outlook. Fetched 2026-11-16

KKO24.cite: A. E. Lanman et al. (CHIME/FRB Collaboration), "CHIME/FRB Outriggers: KKO Station System and Commissioning Results", AJ 168, 87 (2024); arXiv:2402.07898v2 (revised 29 May 2024): Sec. 1, Table 1 (characteristics of KKO), Sec. 2.1-2.3, 3.4.1 (SEFD), 3.5.1 (feed positions), 4.5 (ITRF positions of KKO and CHIME). Fetched 2026-11-16

HCO26.cite: M. Lazda et al., "The CHIME/FRB Outriggers: Commissioning the Hat Creek Outrigger and an Updated Calibration Scheme ...", arXiv:2609.10686v1 (9 Sep 2026): Abstract, Sec. 2.1-2.3, Table 1 (characteristics of HCO). Fetched 2026-11-16

VLBI26.cite: S. Andrew et al., "VLBI Astrometric Procedure and Performance with CHIME/FRB Outriggers", arXiv:2609.38344v1 (29 Sep 2026; submitted to ApJ): Sec. 2 (stations, baselines, beam footprint), Sec. 2.2 and Fig. 5 caption (fitted geocentric station positions of HCO and GBO). Fetched 2026-11-16

EPH.cite: CHIME collaboration software ch_ephem (GitHub chime-experiment/ch_ephem, commit 7ad5dd27f54f, 2026-07-15), ch_ephem/instruments.yaml: latitude, longitude, altitude, rotation and roll of chime, kko, gbo, hco (and galt, tone, pathfinder); also sources.py (the standard calibrator catalogs). Text only; not run. Commit record in github_api_commit_main.json. Fetched 2026-11-16

EPHSRC.cite: As EPH, ch_ephem/sources.py (source_dictionary built from the fluxcat catalogs). Text only; not run. Fetched 2026-11-16

CHUTIL.cite: CHIME collaboration software ch_util (GitHub chime-experiment/ch_util, commit ad4ae0efc7a4, 2026-09-04), ch_util/tools.py: _get_feed_position (feed y offsets in units of 0.3048 m within a cassette) and the cylinder-name map. Text only; not run. Fetched 2026-11-16

FLUX.cite: fluxcat (GitHub radiocosmology/fluxcat, commit 13825228d7e4, last pushed 2026-01-31), fluxcat/catalogs/primary_calibrators_perley2016.json: 20 calibrators with ra, dec (deg), spectral model CurvedPowerLaw and its parameters; the catalog CHIME's ch_ephem loads first. Data only. Fetched 2026-11-16

FLUXCODE.cite: As FLUX, fluxcat/core.py: definition of the CurvedPowerLaw model (ln S = a0 + a1 ln nu' + ..., nu' = nu / freq_pivot) and FREQ_NOMINAL = 600 MHz. Text only; not run. Fetched 2026-11-16

SPECFIND.cite: As FLUX, fluxcat/catalogs/specfind_v2_5Jy_vollmer2009.json (194 sources; ra, dec, power-law fits pivoted at 600 MHz). Data only. Fetched 2026-11-16

WEB.cite: CHIME collaboration web site, Instrument page (chime-experiment.ca; page footer "© 2025"). Response headers in hdr_chime-experiment_instrument.txt. Fetched 2026-11-16

ARXIV.cite: arXiv API metadata (versions, dates, journal references) for the arXiv papers cited here and in chord.md. Fetched 2026-11-16

not_found: Surveyed positions of individual CHIME feeds: the published papers give the rule (256 feeds at 0.3048 m along the central 78 m of each focal line; 22 m between cylinder centers); ch_util reads per-cassette offsets from a layout database that is not public. The positions here follow the rule (INFERRED).
An explicit statement of the cylinder order (A-D west to east): INFERRED from HOLO24 Fig. 10.
The ground height of each cylinder or terrain slope at DRAO: feeds are placed at u = 0 (the focal-line height) as KKO24 does for KKO.

A published E-W primary-beam FWHM as a formula or table vs frequency: only the band-edge values 2.5 and 1.3 deg (FRB18) and the measured scatter plot (OVW22 Fig. 17); the 1.0 deg / nu(GHz) relation is DERIVED.
Right ascensions for Perseus B, 3C273, 3C84, 3C111 and 3C358 (HOLO24 Table 1 lists declination only; neither saved fluxcat catalog contains these five).
A published CHIME declination limit: 3/4 of the sky and 31000 deg2 are stated (OVW22); the southern limit near dec -6 deg is DERIVED from the 110 deg N-S field.
Feed counts that are flagged at a given time (beyond the 16 per cylinder static edge mask and the ~3% broker average).
The GBO station's own commissioning paper (Nimmo et al., in prep., cited by HCO26): GBO's geographic coordinates come from EPH and the VLBI26 fit; its cylinder length and feed count from OUT25.
Survey positions of individual outrigger feeds (DERIVED here from station center + 0.3048 m spacing along the rotated axis; roll left out).
Datum of EPH altitudes (header says above mean sea level; CHIME's value equals its ellipsoidal height).
conflicts: Feed spacing: 0.3048 m (OVW22 Table 2; CHUTIL) vs 305 mm (OVW22 Sec. 2.3; KKO24; OUT25) vs 30 cm (FRB18; OVW22 Sec. 4.5.1). Adopted 0.3048 m (1 ft); the others are roundings.
Instrumented length: central 78 m (OVW22) vs 80 m (FRB18). 256 x 0.3048 = 78.0 m (DERIVED).
N-S beam extent: ~110 deg (FRB18 Table 1, formed-beam tiling) vs ~120 deg (OVW22, HOLO24) vs ~100 deg (VLBI26).
E-W beam width: 2.5-1.3 deg across the band (FRB18) vs 'two degree wide stripe' (OVW22 abstract), 1.5-4 deg measured scatter (OVW22 Fig. 17), '3-degree wide strip' (OUT25).
System temperature: ~50 K with a dim sky (OVW22 Sec. 4.3), 55 K in the forecast (OVW22 App. A), 'Receiver noise temperature 50 K' (FRB18) vs measured receiver temperature 20-25 K (OVW22 Sec. 4.3).
CHIME orientation: a clockwise rotation of 0.071 deg (OVW22, EPH -0.071 anticlockwise) or a -2.73 cm N-S feed offset per cylinder (OVW22); OVW22 adopts the rotation.

CHIME height datum: EPH 555.372 m 'above mean sea level' equals the WGS84 ellipsoidal height of the KKO24 ITRF centroid (555.4 m, DERIVED); KKO24 implies CHIME near 600 m above sea level (KKO at 800 m, '~200 m higher').
CHIME-GBO distance: 3370 km (OUT25) vs 3334 km (VLBI26) vs 3334.12 km chord from the fitted positions (DERIVED).
CHIME-KKO distance: 66.2 km 'projected for a target at the CHIME zenith' (KKO24 Table 1) vs 66 km (OUT25) vs 66.38 km chord and 66.37 km horizontal (DERIVED).

CHIME-HCO distance: 955.2 km 'projected' (HCO26 Table 1) vs 956 km (OUT25), 955 km (VLBI26); DERIVED chord 955.20 km, horizontal 952.55 km. HCO26's 955.2 km equals the chord, not the horizontal projection.
HCO cylinder length: 80 m (HCO26 Table 1 and Sec. 2.2) vs 64 m total for the GBO and HCRO stations (OUT25 Sec. 3.2.3). Instrumented 39 m (HCO26) vs 40 m (OUT25); 128 x 0.3048 = 39.0 m (DERIVED).
HCO orientation: roll 1.4 deg, rotation 1.22 deg 'East of North' (HCO26) vs roll 1.0556, rotation +1.145 anticlockwise, i.e. west of north (EPH). The sense and size of the rotation disagree.
KKO elevation: 800 m (KKO24 Table 1) vs 835 m (EPH, 'rough position') vs 804.2 m ellipsoidal from the fitted ITRF position (DERIVED).
KKO instrumented length: 19.5 m (KKO24 Table 1) vs 'central 20 meters' (KKO24 Sec. 2.2) vs '20m of instrumentation' (OUT25).

Cas A at 600 MHz: 2375 Jy (HOLO24 Table 1) vs 3344 Jy from the fluxcat Perley-2016 fit (DERIVED; the stored CurvedPowerLaw model has no time dependence). Tau A: 1142 Jy (HOLO24) vs 996 Jy (fit). Cyg A agrees (3613 vs 3638 Jy); Vir A 436 vs 421 Jy.

GBO position: EPH gbo record (38.436122, -79.827922, 826.01 m) lies 157 m from the VLBI26 fitted position (DERIVED); EPH also keeps a separate 'tone' record (TONE pathfinder at GBO, 38.4293, -79.8452).
notes: Feed positions: e = -33, -11, +11, +33 m for cylinders A-D (west to east, INFERRED order); n = (k - 127.5) x 0.3048 m for k = 0..255; u = 0. Bmax 101.97 m (A000-D255), Bmin 0.3048 m (DERIVED). The 0.071 deg clockwise structure rotation (OVW22) is left out (4.8 cm at the end feeds).

Beam: each feed's primary beam is ~1.0 deg / nu(GHz) wide east-west (FRB18 band edges 2.5 and 1.3 deg; DERIVED relation) and ~110-120 deg north-south. A source transits in t = FWHM_EW / (15 deg/h x cos dec): 6.7 min / cos dec at 600 MHz (DERIVED).

Outriggers in CHIME's tangent frame (DERIVED from KKO24 and VLBI26 positions): KKO (-65.41, +11.32, -0.10) km, HCO (-155.43, -939.78, -71.15) km, GBO (+3202.38, -323.23, -869.83) km; chords 66.38, 955.20, 3334.12 km; KKO-HCO 957.99 km, KKO-GBO 3398.07 km, HCO-GBO 3506.13 km.

Point-source field: HOLO24 Table 1 (24 sources of 10 Jy or more at 600 MHz, dec -21.5 to +64.8) with RA from fluxcat for 19 of the 24; the four daily calibrators are Cyg A (3613 Jy), Cas A (2375 Jy), Tau A (1142 Jy), Vir A (436 Jy) at 600 MHz (HOLO24).
